description: The failed mark is on disk before the return starts.

input.scenario: Confirmed gen-0041. gen-0042 fails its health check. A fault kills the host after it records gen-0042 as failed and before it changes the active generation. The host restarts.

expect.behaviour: On restart the host sees gen-0042 active and recorded as failed, completes the return to gen-0041 and does not start gen-0042.
